messages:
Maria Chen: Quick flagwe've got a tenant generating ~8 alerts/min on one SLO. Pages are cascading. Thinking about a notify-level damping/circuit breaker to reduce fanout. Wanted to sync on API + Console UX before prototyping.
Kevin Ortiz: Agree on damping vs kill-switch. Token-bucket (leaky bucket) feels right: allow bursts but protect sustained spam.
Anya Patel: UX: do we show a per-SLO suggestion card, or per-tenant policy? Also want to avoid confusing "suppression" with changing SLOs.
Samir Rao: From API side, keep backward compat. Proposal: separate signal_policy resource referenced by slo_id rather than mutating notify_policy. Less coupling in evaluator.
Maria Chen: Console idea: "Noise mitigation suggestions" card on SLO page with estimate (pages avoided), confidence, and dry-run. One-click apply to create a linked signal_policy.
Kevin Ortiz: Telemetry requirement: always emit metrics for suppressed_count and last_suppressed_sample even while suppressing. Also emit suppression_reason tags (e.g., noisy-signal-protection).
Anya Patel: Visual: timeline overlay on SLO graph showing suppression bands (grey) with hover details and a CTA to run a simulation for chosen time window.
Samir Rao: Minimal config sketch: 
```
signal_policy:
  id: "sp-123"
  linked_slo: "slo-456"
  mode: "token_bucket"
  rate_per_min: 30
  burst: 60
  window_seconds: 600
  emit_metrics: true
```
Keep defaults conservative.
Maria Chen: Rollout: stage-only suggestion mode (no suppression) for 2 weeks, then pilot opt-in for 5 tenants behind FF, then gradual ramp with automated rollback if false-negative rate > 1%.
deploy-bot: feature-flag update: "slo-notify-damping" enabled in staging for pilot tenants.
Kevin Ortiz: Simulation: reuse sampling pipeline to replay signals. For high-volume tenants run approximated sim and return CI on pages avoided.
Anya Patel: Product ask: add explainer copy for "what suppression does" and list which channels are affected vs which always pass through (e.g., legal/SEC alerts always bypass).
Samir Rao: Compatibility note: evaluator must record suppressed decisions in an append-only audit stream so incident analytics can reconstruct. Include suppression tags in event envelope.
Maria Chen: I'll draft RFC with API contract, console mocks, telemetry schema, and rollout checklist. Volunteers to co-author?
Kevin Ortiz: I'll take the sampling/sim portion.
Samir Rao: I'll take API compatibility and audit stream.
Anya Patel: I'll do UI mocks and copy.
Maria Chen: Thanks all. Target RFC by next Thu.
